LESSON: SOUND

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.3: Sound
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sound, part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do animals and other objects in our environment produce sounds? 2. Why are some sounds important in our lives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sound together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: A learner interacts with digital devices with assistive technology as they observe safety precautions while using digital devices

when recording audios or videos on various sounds.

Self-efficacy: A learner exhibits confidence as they imitate various sounds produced by animals or objects.

Values:
Patriotism: A learner enriches loyalty as they obey laws and regulation on sounds that alert us on dangers for appropriate response.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: A learner uses common courteous words as they engage in identifying sounds inferring danger.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Sounds in the immediate environment draws concepts in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, local environment, digital devices with assistive technology, manilla papers, marker pens, animals,

objects.
